note: Transcribed from the cited original screenshots. Historical cards do not establish current release status. Two titles are outside the visible crop and remain partial.

traits.name: What Should I Do? II
traits.exact_visible_text: The first time Aegon II becomes Debuffed each turn, he grants his allies a 20% Power Buff for 3 turns.

traits.name: Drinks For All II
traits.exact_visible_text: Aegon II begins combat with +8 BIRTHRIGHT and +75% Stamina. He loses 1 additional BIRTHRIGHT per turn. When he loses BIRTHRIGHT, the team gains +10% Stamina.

traits.name: Three Strong Boys II
traits.exact_visible_text: The first 3 times enemies are defeated, all team members gain +2 BIRTHRIGHT and an indefinite +5% Power Buff.

traits.name: I Intend To Be Found II
traits.exact_visible_text: Aemond begins combat with 8 BIRTHRIGHT and 75% Stamina. When enemies take Critical Damage from a Skill, Aemond gains +1 BIRTHRIGHT.

traits.name: Rise Of Dragons II
traits.exact_visible_text: When Caraxes destroys a Hazard, he replaces it with a Red Dragon Gem. When using Bloodwyrm's Shriek, he reduces enemy ATK by -15% for 3 turns.

traits.name: Fury Of Dragons
traits.exact_visible_text: When any Dragon team member uses their Skill, Caraxes gains 1 FURY. If he is ENRAGED, all other Dragons gain 1 FURY instead.

traits.name: Title not visible in source
traits.exact_visible_text: Once per turn, when a RAIDED enemy is defeated, Theon REMOVES 2 Debuffs from each team member, and the one who landed the final blow has 2 more REMOVED. Team members gain +5% ATK for 2 turns for each RAID they inflict.

traits.name: The Prince Of Two Houses III
traits.exact_visible_text: Theon counts as a member of both the Stark and Greyjoy Factions. When an enemy becomes BRITTLE, Theon strikes them for 125% ATK Physical Damage. When a RAIDED enemy is defeated, Theon strikes a random enemy for the same damage.

traits.name: Title not visible in source
traits.exact_visible_text: Thoros no longer hurts himself when REVIVING an ally. Thoros and all allied Menders begin combat with an additional 25% Crit Chance. When a champion REINFORCES your side of the battle, they gain an indefinite 100% Crit Chance buff.

traits.name: Flaming Sword III
traits.exact_visible_text: Anytime an ally Critically Strikes an opponent with their Skill, Thoros will strike that opponent for 75% ATK Fire Damage and afflict his target with FIRE. Thoros then HEALS the ally for 15% ATK. This HEAL can critically HEAL.

traits.name: The Gold Will Be Divided II
traits.exact_visible_text: At battle start, Tyland adds 4 Coins to the TREASURY. If a Greens ally is on the team, all allies gain +50% ATK Buff for 3 turns. When a team member spends Coins, Tyland strikes the Weakest enemy for +200% ATK Physical Damage and grants +2 BIRTHRIGHT to all Greens allies.

traits.name: Born To Endure III
traits.exact_visible_text: Tyland begins combat with 35% DEF Buff for 3 turns and 80% Stamina. When an ally uses their Skill, Tyland applies 1 GOLDEN BASTION to all team members.

traits.name: Dominating Presence
traits.exact_visible_text: All allies begin combat in STEALTH for 10 turns. When Wun Wun is defeated REMOVE STEALTH from all allies.

traits.name: Sizable Fortitude II
traits.exact_visible_text: At the start of the battle, Wun Wun gains a 35% Max HP SHIELD. At the start of each turn, if Wun Wun is SHIELDED, he gains +10% Physical Resistance for 1 turn.

traits.name: Claimant Of The Salt Throne II
traits.exact_visible_text: When Yara defeats a RAIDED enemy, she will STUN a random target for 2 turns and REMOVE 1 Debuff from all team members.

traits.name: Ironborn III
traits.exact_visible_text: While Yara is below 50% HP, she will strike enemies who become RAIDED for 50% ATK Physical Damage. This attack REMOVES 1 Buff from the target.
